text.p: The following are top headlines from selected Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Ontario among top polluters: Province follows two U.S. states as worst offenders in North America, according to study
Alaska asking for millions in salmon row: State's Attorney-General flatly refuses to meet with Clark on Vancouver trip
Death most common on frosty Saturday: Findings raise questions about whether people can plan timimg of their demise
Breast cancer deaths decline: Better detection, treatment cited
Housing crisis afflict Inuit: Northern Quebec communities resemble those in developing countries; often there are a dozen people crammed into tiny, substandard shelter
Gulf to take over Stampeder: Friendly stock swap is valued at $688-million; Bryan says deal belies company's reputation as a bully
Royal vetoed Gandalf deal: bidder: Bank decided buyout not sweet enough, said it could get more by selling assets, Kasten Chase says
Prime Vancouver site on block: Marathon expects Coal Harbour lands to fetch $300-million
Parmalat mergers Beatrice, Ault: Unit will have $1.9-billion in sales
Gulf bids $1B for Stampeder: Friendly takeover will create one of Canada's largest portfolios of undeveloped lands, the combined companies having some 5.8 million acres between them
Blockbuster lawsuit draws Barrick into Bre-X furore
